metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2025 · Boots
metas.description: Bullied gay teen Cameron joins the Marine Corps with his best friend despite risks. In boot camp they experience profound personal change amid danger, as their platoon confronts both literal and figurative landmines.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2023 · The Prince
metas.description: Following the suspicious death of the Bongomian king, his disregarded prince assumes the throne, initiating an intricate tale.
In this satirical comedy, a zany nobleman navigates through family feuds and clashes with peasants in his quest to become Poland's most famous figure.
